params.place: on the map: all of India, Keralam lit at the southern tip and Arunachal Pradesh at the north-east corner

moments.what: Keralam traces round its border and glows green
Arunachal Pradesh traces and glows the same green
a dotted arc draws from Keralam's tip to Arunachal's corner
a bird silhouette flies along the arc
a big question mark stamps on the middle of India as the camera pushes in

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: केरलम और अरुणाचल, भारत के दो सिरे, फिर भी पक्षी एक क्यों?

params.place: on the map: a wooden signboard standing in the Bay of Bengal beside all of India

moments.what: the camera pulls back to all of India and a wooden signboard rises in the Bay of Bengal with the count
every state's border flashes white in a wave from west to east
a bird badge stamps onto the signboard
an arrow on the map swings up to point north

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: 28 स्टेट्स, और हर स्टेट का अपना ऑफिशियल पक्षी। चलिए, उत्तर से।

params.place: on the map: the Himalayan north, from Punjab across the hills to the Ganga plain of Uttar Pradesh

moments.what: Punjab paints in and its tag बाज़ pops up
Himachal Pradesh paints in, tag जुजुराना
Uttarakhand paints in, tag मोनाल
Uttar Pradesh paints in, tag सारस, the camera drifts south-east

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: पंजाब का बाज़, हिमाचल जुजुराना, उत्तराखंड मोनाल, उत्तर प्रदेश सारस।

params.place: on the map: the west and the middle, the Thar desert of Rajasthan down to the Deccan of Maharashtra

moments.what: Rajasthan paints in, tag गोडावण
Gujarat paints in, tag फ्लेमिंगो
Madhya Pradesh paints in, tag दूधराज
the camera pushes in as Maharashtra paints in, tag हरियल

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: राजस्थान गोडावण, गुजरात फ्लेमिंगो, मध्य प्रदेश दूधराज, महाराष्ट्र हरियल।

params.place: on the map: the east, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal down to the Bay of Bengal

moments.what: Bihar paints in, tag गौरैया
Jharkhand paints in, tag कोयल
West Bengal paints in, tag किलकिला
the camera swings south over the pale peninsula
three pale southern states blink with question tags

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: बिहार गौरैया, झारखंड कोयल, बंगाल किलकिला। पर दक्षिण में ये क्या?

params.place: on the map: the Deccan, Karnataka to Telangana across to the Odisha coast

moments.what: Karnataka paints roller blue, tag नीलकंठ
Telangana paints the same blue, tag नीलकंठ
Odisha paints the same blue, tag नीलकंठ
the real Indian roller drops onto the three states as a die-cut sticker and the camera pushes in
the camera pulls up and two pale question tags blink on Keralam and Arunachal

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: कर्नाटक नीलकंठ, तेलंगाना नीलकंठ, ओडिशा भी नीलकंठ! तो दो सिरों वाले स्टेट्स का?

params.place: on the map: both ends of India at once, the green tip of Keralam and the green corner of Arunachal

moments.what: Keralam lifts green with its tag
Arunachal lifts green with its tag
a bright arc joins the two states
the real great hornbill sticker drops onto the middle of India
both tags flip to धनेश

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: केरलम और अरुणाचल, दोनों का पक्षी है धनेश, ग्रेट हॉर्नबिल।

params.place: on the map: the forests of the Western Ghats along the west coast, then the hills of the north-east

moments.what: the green states glow
trees sprout along the map
a belt of forest grows down the Western Ghats with a tag पश्चिमी घाट
forest spreads over the north-east hills, tag पूर्वोत्तर, a drawn hornbill flies between the two belts

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: ये दोनों तरफ़ के घने जंगलों में रहता है, पश्चिमी घाट में भी, पूर्वोत्तर में भी।

params.place: on the map: the whole of India filled in, every state's colour

moments.what: the three roller-blue states pulse with a नीलकंठ pill
the two hornbill-green states pulse with a धनेश pill
every remaining state paints in, the map fills
the other states fade back to paper
only Keralam and Arunachal stay green, as in the first frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: नीलकंठ या धनेश, आपका पसंदीदा कौन-सा? और फिर से देखिए,
